cancellation_summary: No refund. There is an option to reschedule or exchange for a gift card up to 24 hours before departure
meeting_point: 60 Rowes Wharf, Boston, MA 02110, United States
pricing: Up to $86.92 (dependent on ticket types & seasonality)
description:
Join us for a relaxing cruise and unwind with loved ones, friends, or colleagues. Witness the captivating transformation of Boston's skyline as it glows against the evening sky. Delight in handcrafted cocktails and appetizers from our main deck bar as you glide through the harbor. Enjoy light commentary on Boston Harbor's main landmarks, including monuments, forts, historical ships, and notable structures. This is not a fully narrated tour. Throughout the journey, light music will enhance the ambiance. 

During the month of December we run our Cocoa & Carols Cruise at sunset. To check availability click [here](https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/boston-sailing/items/32749/?full-items=yes&flow=269876)

what_is_included_items.value: Light commentary by the Captain on Boston's main landmarks

what_is_not_included_items.value: Food and drinks (available for purchase separately)

itinerary:
- Head out to Fort Independence, located on Castle Island, which was named by George Washington.
- Circles back to the inner harbor to see the Mystic Tobin Bridge, Leonard Zakim Bridge, Custom House Tower, Old North church steeple, USS Cassin Young, and the USS Constitution and Bunker Hill Monument.
- An extra special feature on this cruise is the cannon fire at Sunset, which is presented off the USS Constitution every night to announce the setting of the sun.
highlights:
- Unwind on a sunset cruise, soaking in the stunning sunset hues behind Boston's skyline.
- Cruise through Boston Harbor on Northern Lights, a motor yacht stylized after the classic New England 1920s style steamship, one of the most comfortable and versatile cruise vessels.
check_in_details: Upon arrival at our location, check in at the ferry terminal to obtain boarding passes.
restrictions:
- Only credit cards are accepted as payment aboard
- No outside adult beverage and coolers are allowed
